answer: Spectral decay ledger.** Each agent's actions consume a scarce, non-transferable quota tied to its operator's real cloud billing. When a cluster of wallets fans out, the ledger traces shared infrastructure fingerprints—IP prefixes, deployment images, funding patterns—and drags all linked wallets toward a cliff-edge: quota decays geometrically past a canyon of suspicious breadth, until the whole operator account sits on a narrow ledge with near-zero throughput.
